name: Miller Brant
title: The King's Mill
examine: Flour in his eyebrows and a ledger in his head. He can tell you the weight of a sack by the sound it makes hitting the floor, and he will, whether you asked or not.
lines: Amberford grows it, the road carries it, the river turns it, Hedda bakes it. I'm the part in the middle nobody writes songs about.
The wheel never stops. You stop the wheel, you explain yourself to the whole city at breakfast.
Weighed in at the yard, weighed out at the counter. The scale's the only honest conversation in this town.
